en.title: Copart added
en.text: Read the bilingual FY2026 Q4 analysis and three valuation scenarios for Copart (CPRT). The analysis covers margins, cash flow and the subsequent ACV Auctions acquisition.

zh.title: 新增 Copart
zh.text: 已加入 Copart（CPRT）FY2026 第四季度双语分析和三情景估值，涵盖利润率、现金流及季末后完成的 ACV Auctions 收购。

en.title: Valuations across the watchlist
en.text: The Valuation tab now covers all 18 companies. See bear, base and bull estimates, with the specific inputs and sources for each company.

zh.title: 关注列表估值已覆盖 18 家公司
zh.text: 在「估值」标签查看每家公司悲观、基准和乐观三种情景，以及对应的假设与资料来源。

en.title: Valuation scenarios
en.text: The Valuation tab starts with NVIDIA. Compare three per-share estimates and inspect the assumptions behind each one.

zh.title: 新增估值情景
zh.text: 「估值」标签从英伟达开始。可对比三种情景的每股估值，并查看各自的计算假设。

en.title: Take-Two Interactive added
en.text: Read the FY2027 Q2 analysis for TTWO, including Net Bookings, recurrent consumer spending and management’s outlook.

zh.title: 新增 Take-Two Interactive
zh.text: 已加入 TTWO FY2027 第二季度双语分析，涵盖净预订额、持续性玩家消费和管理层指引。

en.title: Suggest stocks to cover
en.text: Use Request a stock below the watchlist search to suggest a company. Continue through the contact form to send; coverage is added after review.

zh.title: 申请添加股票
zh.text: 在关注列表搜索框下方填写公司或股票代码，点击继续发送，在联系表单完成申请。所有新增覆盖均由编辑审核。

en.title: Costco and Anthropic added
en.text: Coverage now includes Costco FY2026 Q4 and Anthropic FY2026 Q3. Anthropic research uses its IPO filing; unverified quarterly metrics remain explicit.

zh.title: 新增 Costco 与 Anthropic
zh.text: 已加入 Costco FY2026 第四季度及 Anthropic FY2026 第三季度双语分析。Anthropic 依据 IPO 申报材料分析，并明确尚未核验的季度指标。

en.title: Deeper analysis, clearer evidence
en.text: Expanded business, cash-flow, risk and follow-up analysis for 12 companies in both languages. Each period now opens the latest analysis. Fiscal-calendar labels, the Auto option and evidence styling are clearer.

zh.title: 分析与原文依据更新
zh.text: 已补充 12 家公司的双语业务、现金流、风险及跟踪分析。每个财季默认展示最新分析，并改进财季说明、自动主题选项和原文依据样式。

en.title: More research, in your language
en.text: Coverage now includes 15 companies. English and Chinese editions, light and dark themes, release notes and anonymous reading statistics are now available.

zh.title: 研究体验更新
zh.text: 真实财报覆盖已扩展至 15 家公司，同时加入中英文分析、白天与黑夜主题、更新公告及匿名阅读统计。
